def test_phase_crossing_resets_only_final_and_retains_delay(world):

    b,s,r,rec=world;u=s.units[b.boss_id];u.hp=4000;u.broken=True;u.toughness=0;u.remaining_distance=Fraction(12500);u.charging='boss_charge';s.enrage_stacks=3
